title: 🥕Taproot Assets
desc: Taproot Assets (formerly Taro) — issuing assets on Bitcoin that can move over Lightning.

msgs.text: What is Taproot Assets? Taproot Assets (formerly Taro) is a Lightning Labs protocol for issuing assets on Bitcoin. It uses Taproot to commit asset data on the bitcoin blockchain, and those assets can be transferred over the Lightning Network.

River's explainer now uses the Taproot Assets name (the older URL still works):
https://river.com/learn/what-is-taro-in-bitcoin/

Lightning Labs docs:
https://docs.lightning.engineering/the-lightning-network/taproot-assets
